name: AI Use Levels

tokens.name: Suggested
tokens.meaning: It could change nothing by itself. A person moved every piece of its output into the work (pasted, typed, accepted, pressed send).
tokens.test: Did anything take effect except by a person's own action? No.

tokens.name: Supervised
tokens.meaning: It made changes itself, and each change waited for a person's yes before it took effect.
tokens.test: Could a person have stopped every change before it counted? Yes.

tokens.name: Unattended
tokens.meaning: It made changes itself without waiting for anyone.
tokens.test: Did anything take effect before a person could stop it? Yes.

tokens.name: touched
tokens.meaning: Corrections and local changes to a person's material: polish, autocomplete, spot fixes, formatting.
tokens.test: Would a reader recognise anything of its output in the final? Barely.

tokens.name: drafted
tokens.meaning: It produced a first version a person substantially reworked.
tokens.test: Its shape survives; most of the words or code are a person's.

tokens.name: made
tokens.meaning: The final is substantially its output; a person chose, read, maybe trimmed.
tokens.test: Its words, code or pixels survive.

tokens.name: undo
tokens.meaning: Everything it changed can be reversed by the tagger alone, asking nobody: a branch, a versioned document, a trash can, a staging system nobody else saw.
tokens.test: Could you put it all back in minutes without telling anyone? Yes.

tokens.name: no undo
tokens.meaning: At least one change cannot be taken back: sent, paid, deployed, deleted without backup, published, told someone. Reaching a person or system you do not control always counts, even if a rollback exists, because they saw it.
tokens.test: Did anything leave your control? Yes.

tokens.name: unread
tokens.meaning: No accountable person has read the result. A state, not a level: it is removed when a person reads.
tokens.test: Has someone accountable for the work read the result? No.

absence: No tag means nothing claimed. It never means L0.

marksStatus.braille: braille spells the level token (L0 to L3); brailleName spells the level name; both uncontracted UEB, pending a braille reader's check
